name: neweast-arabia
description: Neweast Arabia holding website, CMS dashboard, and NestJS API

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,cms -c red,blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:cms"
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run prisma:migrate --prefix backend -- --name init && npm run prisma:seed --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix website && npm run build --prefix dashboard
